spec.description: Dashboard de recomendações baseadas no comportamento histórico de insumos do restaurante

spec.rawSql: SELECT SUM(h.quantidadeRetirada) AS value FROM historicoLote h WHERE MONTH(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = YEAR(CURDATE());

SELECT i.nome AS insumo, SUM(h.quantidadeRetirada) AS total_retiradas FROM historicoLote h INNER JOIN lote l ON l.idLote = h.fkLote INNER JOIN marca m ON m.idMarca = l.fkMarca INNER JOIN insumo i ON i.idInsumo = m.fkInsumo WHERE MONTH(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY i.idInsumo, i.nome ORDER BY total_retiradas DESC LIMIT 10;

spec.title: Distribuição de Retiradas por Categoria (Mês Atual)

spec.rawSql: SELECT c.nome AS categoria, SUM(h.quantidadeRetirada) AS total_retiradas FROM historicoLote h INNER JOIN lote l ON l.idLote = h.fkLote INNER JOIN marca m ON m.idMarca = l.fkMarca INNER JOIN insumo i ON i.idInsumo = m.fkInsumo INNER JOIN categoria c ON c.idCategoria = i.fkCategoria WHERE MONTH(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY c.idCategoria, c.nome ORDER BY total_retiradas DESC;

spec.title: ⬆️ Insumos com Alta no Consumo — Reposição Maior Recomendada

spec.rawSql: SELECT i.nome AS insumo, c.nome AS categoria, COALESCE(ant.total, 0) AS mes_anterior, COALESCE(atu.total, 0) AS mes_atual, ROUND(((COALESCE(atu.total, 0) - COALESCE(ant.total, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ant.total, 1), 0)) * 100, 1) AS variacao_percentual, CONCAT('Repor ', COALESCE(atu.total, 0), ' un. (alta de ', ROUND(((COALESCE(atu.total, 0) - COALESCE(ant.total, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ant.total, 1), 0)) * 100, 0), '%)') AS recomendacao FROM insumo i INNER JOIN categoria c ON c.idCategoria = i.fkCategoria LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.fkInsumo, SUM(h.quantidadeRetirada) AS total FROM historicoLote h INNER JOIN lote l ON l.idLote = h.fkLote INNER JOIN marca m ON m.idMarca = l.fkMarca WHERE MONTH(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY m.fkInsumo ) atu ON atu.fkInsumo = i.idInsumo LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.fkInsumo, SUM(h.quantidadeRetirada) AS total FROM historicoLote h INNER JOIN lote l ON l.idLote = h.fkLote INNER JOIN marca m ON m.idMarca = l.fkMarca WHERE MONTH(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND YEAR(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) GROUP BY m.fkInsumo ) ant ON ant.fkInsumo = i.idInsumo WHERE i.ativo = 1 AND COALESCE(atu.total, 0) > COALESCE(ant.total, 0) ORDER BY variacao_percentual DESC LIMIT 15;

spec.title: ⬇️ Insumos com Queda no Consumo — Reposição Menor Recomendada

spec.rawSql: SELECT i.nome AS insumo, c.nome AS categoria, COALESCE(ant.total, 0) AS mes_anterior, COALESCE(atu.total, 0) AS mes_atual, ROUND(((COALESCE(atu.total, 0) - COALESCE(ant.total, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ant.total, 1), 0)) * 100, 1) AS variacao_percentual FROM insumo i INNER JOIN categoria c ON c.idCategoria = i.fkCategoria LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.fkInsumo, SUM(h.quantidadeRetirada) AS total FROM historicoLote h INNER JOIN lote l ON l.idLote = h.fkLote INNER JOIN marca m ON m.idMarca = l.fkMarca WHERE MONTH(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY m.fkInsumo ) atu ON atu.fkInsumo = i.idInsumo LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.fkInsumo, SUM(h.quantidadeRetirada) AS total FROM historicoLote h INNER JOIN lote l ON l.idLote = h.fkLote INNER JOIN marca m ON m.idMarca = l.fkMarca WHERE MONTH(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND YEAR(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) GROUP BY m.fkInsumo ) ant ON ant.fkInsumo = i.idInsumo WHERE i.ativo = 1 AND COALESCE(atu.total, 0) < COALESCE(ant.total, 0) ORDER BY variacao_percentual ASC LIMIT 15;

spec.title: Melhor Fornecedor por Insumo (baseado no histórico de preços)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT insumo, categoria, fornecedor_recomendado, telefone, whatsapp,
       preco_medio, preco_minimo, total_compras
FROM (
    SELECT
        i.nome AS insumo,
        cat.nome AS categoria,
        f.razaoSocial AS fornecedor_recomendado,
        f.telefone AS telefone,
        f.linkWhatsapp AS whatsapp,
        ROUND(AVG(l.precoUnit), 2) AS preco_medio,
        ROUND(MIN(l.precoUnit), 2) AS preco_minimo,
        COUNT(l.idLote) AS total_compras,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.idInsumo
            ORDER BY AVG(l.precoUnit) ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM lote l
    INNER JOIN marca m ON m.idMarca = l.fkMarca
    INNER JOIN insumo i ON i.idInsumo = m.fkInsumo
    INNER JOIN categoria cat ON cat.idCategoria = i.fkCategoria
    INNER JOIN fornecedor f ON f.idFornecedor = m.fkFornecedor
    WHERE i.ativo = 1
    GROUP BY i.idInsumo, i.nome, cat.nome, f.idFornecedor, f.razaoSocial, f.telefone, f.linkWhatsapp
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY insumo;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.idInsumo) AS value FROM insumo i WHERE i.ativo = 1 AND i.idInsumo NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l2.fkMarca FROM lote l2 INNER JOIN historicoLote h ON h.fkLote = l2.idLote WHERE MONTH(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(h.dataHoraAlteracao) = YEAR(CURDATE()) );
SELECT SUM(l.quantidadeAtual * l.precoUnit) AS value FROM lote l WHERE l.ativo = 1;

spec.title: Evolução Mensal de Retiradas por Categoria (Últimos 6 Meses)

spec.rawSql: SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(h.dataHoraAlteracao, '%Y-%m-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')) * 1000 AS time, c.nome AS metric, SUM(h.quantidadeRetirada) AS value FROM historicoLote h INNER JOIN lote l ON l.idLote = h.fkLote INNER JOIN marca m ON m.idMarca = l.fkMarca INNER JOIN insumo i ON i.idInsumo = m.fkInsumo INNER JOIN categoria c ON c.idCategoria = i.fkCategoria WHERE h.dataHoraAlteracao >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY UNIX_TIMESTAMP(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(h.dataHoraAlteracao, '%Y-%m-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')) * 1000, c.idCategoria, c.nome ORDER BY time ASC;

spec.title: Previsão de Ruptura de Estoque — Insumos de Alta Rotatividade
spec.description: Baseado na média de retiradas dos últimos 30 dias. Vermelho = menos de 4 dias, Amarelo = menos de 7 dias.

spec.rawSql: SELECT i.nome AS insumo, c.nome AS categoria, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantidadeAtual), 0) AS estoque_atual, ROUND(COALESCE(hist.total_retirado, 0) / 30, 2) AS media_retirada_dia, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(l.quantidadeAtual), 0) / NULLIF(ROUND(COALESCE(hist.total_retirado, 0) / 30, 2), 0), 0) AS dias_ate_zerar FROM insumo i INNER JOIN categoria c ON c.idCategoria = i.fkCategoria LEFT JOIN marca m ON m.fkInsumo = i.idInsumo LEFT JOIN lote l ON l.fkMarca = m.idMarca AND l.ativo = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m2.fkInsumo, SUM(h.quantidadeRetirada) AS total_retirado FROM historicoLote h INNER JOIN lote l2 ON l2.idLote = h.fkLote INNER JOIN marca m2 ON m2.idMarca = l2.fkMarca WHERE h.dataHoraAlteracao >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY m2.fkInsumo ) hist ON hist.fkInsumo = i.idInsumo WHERE i.ativo = 1 AND i.rotatividade = 1 GROUP BY i.idInsumo, i.nome, c.nome, hist.total_retirado HAVING media_retirada_dia > 0 ORDER BY dias_ate_zerar ASC;
